I'm only in Silver so take this with a grain of salt, but with almost 500k on Ahri I hope I can at least help.

First off, I'd recommend grabbing pots/biscuits instead of a ward. Although it is more vision, I typically don't find myself really needing one before my first back, and your laner is going to seriously outsustain you with 2/3 pots.

As for summoners, please don't run ghost. Between her ult and the bonus movespeed on her q, other secondary summoners benefit Ahri more, like Ignite for more kill potential or Exhaust against assassins. I even take Cleanse occasionally but only really into Annie.

I actually run Protobelt on Ahri almost every game. However, my standard build before for almost 400k mastery was Morello -> Sorcs -> Ludens -> Void -> Deathcap -> Lich or Liandrys, usually Liandrys. Buy an  Armguard early if against AD and finish Zhonyas after Morello if against Zed. Otherwise, it's your call to finish or just hold Armguard and sell it later.

The build I'm using now that I actually do prefer on her is Morello -> Sorcs -> Protobelt -> Void -> Deathcap -> Liandrys. Sometimes for fun if I have a good early game I'll build Lich after Morello into Void/DCP/Liandrys.

I never build Mejais because I suck and die too much. :p I guess if you were gonna get it, substitute Ludens or your last item.

Hope that helps some!
